description: By combining Creative Industries with Healthcare & Life Sciences, our project transforms complex astronaut physiological data into an immersive, highly intuitive visual experience. We leverage advanced UI/UX design, 3D data visualization, and interactive dashboards to ensure that health monitoring on space missions is not only medically accurate but also fast and engaging.

details:
ASTROGUARD is an offline-first health monitoring web platform designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It addresses the challenges of maintaining human health in space, where radiation exposure, isolation, sleep disturbances, and changes in gravity can affect astronauts' physical and psychological well-being.

How It Works:

ASTROGUARD provides an organized interface that allows astronauts to record and monitor important health indicators, including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, sleep duration, and mood.

The platform also includes a Radiation Monitor section for recording and reviewing radiation exposure information obtained from external devices, such as dosimeters. Its Health Insights feature uses predefined JavaScript rules to identify unusual changes in recorded values and provide general preventive recommendations. Additionally, the Reports section organizes health information into structured reports that can support communication with medical teams.

One of its main features is its offline-first functionality. The platform uses browser LocalStorage to save health records locally, allowing users to access their information without a continuous internet connection.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

ASTROGUARD aims to improve astronauts' awareness of their health conditions, make health information easier to track, and support early recognition of unusual changes. It also helps organize health records, which may assist medical teams in reviewing astronauts' conditions during long-duration missions.

Creativity and Innovation:

The creative aspect of ASTROGUARD lies in combining several health-monitoring features into one accessible platform designed specifically for the challenges of space exploration. Its offline-first approach considers communication limitations during distant space missions, while its organized dashboard makes health information easier to understand and review.

Tools and Technologies:

We developed the platform using:

  • HTML for the website structure.
  • CSS for the visual design and responsive interface.
  • JavaScript for interactive features and rule-based health insights.
  • Browser LocalStorage for local data storage.
  • ChatGPT and Claude as supporting AI tools to help with some coding tasks and technical challenges.

Factors Considered:

During development, we considered astronauts' limited access to medical support, communication delays, the importance of data accessibility, ease of use, and the need for clear and organized health information. We also considered scientific accuracy and the limitations of our current prototype.

ASTROGUARD is designed as a health-monitoring and decision-support concept. It does not provide medical diagnoses, independently measure radiation, or replace professional medical evaluation.
